arguments.sql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_usd DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Sums every transaction amount per user (through each user's cards) and returns the five largest totals in dollars, highest first.
assumptions: Spend is the net sum of amount_usd_cents over all transactions, including the 56,900 rows with negative amounts, which are not treated as refunds or removed.
All transactions are counted, including those without a fraud label.
Ties in total are broken by ascending user id.
The period is the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
